replacement: A command computes all files it owns in a temporary sibling directory and atomically replaces them only after successful validation. `run` replaces the complete listed set and removes no unlisted path.

products.field_order: Every JSON object is emitted with sort_keys, so field order is lexicographic by key name.

cast.latitude_deg: header latitude as a reduced positive fraction object {num, den}, both integers
cast.bin_size_m: bin size as a reduced positive fraction object {num, den}, both integers
cast.candidate_latitudes_deg: array of candidate latitudes, each a reduced positive fraction, ordered ascending by num/den

samples.sample_id: canonical identifier S000001, S000002, ... assigned in (time_s, pressure_dbar, temperature_c, conductivity_mS) order
samples.time_s: scaled integer copied from the shard row
samples.pressure_dbar: scaled integer copied from the shard row
samples.temperature_c: scaled integer copied from the shard row
samples.conductivity_mS: scaled integer copied from the shard row
samples.duplicate_count: number of identical shard rows collapsed into this sample, counting the retained row, so an unduplicated sample is 1

downcast-segment.json.downcast_sample_count: number of sample_ids in the downcast
downcast-segment.json.downcast_sample_ids: array of downcast sample_id strings in downcast order
downcast-segment.json.start_time_s: time_s of the first downcast sample
downcast-segment.json.end_time_s: time_s of the last downcast sample
downcast-segment.json.max_pressure_dbar: pressure_dbar of the last downcast sample
downcast-segment.json.upcast_discarded_count: number of normalized samples not in the downcast

depth-profile.jsonl.depth_micro_m: depth from the contract depth conversion at the working latitude

binned-profile.jsonl.sample_count: number of derived rows in the bin

candidate_trials.latitude_deg: the candidate latitude as a reduced positive fraction object {num, den}, both integers
candidate_trials.density_inversion_count: contract density_inversion count for this candidate

latitude-diagnosis.json.candidate_trials_order: ascending by latitude_deg num then den
latitude-diagnosis.json.inferred_latitude_deg: the winning candidate under the contract objective
latitude-diagnosis.json.objective_score: two-element array [density_inversion_count, survey_tie_mse_micro] of the winning candidate

density_inversion.bin_floor_micro_m: bin where density decreased with depth

qc-flags.jsonl.emptiness: A run with no flags emits a zero-byte file.
qc-flags.jsonl.ordering: Ascending by code, then by bin_floor_micro_m; a flag with no bin_floor_micro_m sorts as if that value were -1.

final-profile.jsonl.bin_floor_micro_m: as in binned-profile.jsonl, recomputed at the inferred latitude
final-profile.jsonl.depth_micro_m: as in binned-profile.jsonl, recomputed at the inferred latitude

provenance.json.input_sample_count: number of entries in normalized-input.json samples
provenance.json.product_sha256: lowercase hex sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps({"diagnosis": <latitude-diagnosis.json>, "flags": <qc-flags.jsonl as an array of objects>, "final": <final-profile.jsonl as an array of objects>, "segment": <downcast-segment.json>}, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2, sort_keys=True) followed by one newline
